description: This file defines the 'browser' class for handling file browsing, uploading, downloading, and directory management within the KCFinder project. It manages thumbnail directories, file operations, and server responses for a web-based file manager.

classes.name: browser
classes.description: Class for managing file browsing, directory operations, and file uploads/downloads in the KCFinder web file manager.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the browser object, sets up thumbnail directories, and cleans up old zip files.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Determines and executes the appropriate action method based on request parameters.

methods.name: act_browser
methods.description: Handles directory navigation within the browser.

methods.name: act_init
methods.description: Initializes directory tree and file list for the client.

methods.name: act_thumb
methods.description: Serves thumbnail images or default icons for files.

methods.name: act_downloadDir
methods.description: Creates and serves a zip archive of a directory.

methods.name: act_downloadSelected
methods.description: Creates and serves a zip archive of selected files.

methods.name: act_downloadClipboard
methods.description: Creates and serves a zip archive of clipboard files.

methods.name: sendDefaultThumb
methods.description: Serves a default icon or thumbnail image.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves list of files with metadata in a directory.

methods.name: xmlTree
methods.description: Generates XML representation of directory tree.

methods.name: postDir
methods.description: Returns the current directory path from POST data, with validation.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the current directory path from GET data, with validation.

methods.name: output
methods.description: Renders output using templates or returns empty string.
